perplexity.description:
The album Loaded by Various Artists, released under the Virgin and EMI labels, is a compilation that blends electronic and rock genres, reflecting early 1990s dance and alternative music scenes. It was part of EMI and Virgin's CDEVP series, specifically released in 1993, showcasing a mix of influential tracks from artists like Primal Scream, Stereo MCs, and Depeche Mode. The compilation captures the era's fusion of rock energy with electronic production, featuring notable songs such as Primal Scream's "Loaded" and Stereo MCs' "Connected," which highlight the crossover appeal between club culture and rock audiences.

This album holds significance as a snapshot of the evolving music landscape of the early '90s, where electronic dance music began to permeate mainstream rock and pop. Unlike a traditional artist album, Loaded serves as a curated collection that introduces listeners to key tracks emblematic of the period's hybrid sound. While it does not belong to a single artist's discography, its commercial reception was tied to the popularity of the included singles and the growing interest in electronic-infused rock music. The compilation was part of a series that aimed to capitalize on the rave and dance movement, making it a relevant document of its time rather than a landmark release in its own right.
